info.title: CODESYS Automation API
info.description: REST API for automating CODESYS project, POU, PLC binding, and Modbus RS485 configuration workflows.

get.summary: List projects known to the CODESYS session

post.description: Project open can take 30-90 seconds for large projects.

get.summary: Read POU declaration and implementation text

post.summary: Write POU declaration and/or implementation text

get.summary: List project device and application targets

post.summary: Validate deploy target inputs without connecting or downloading
Scan or query PLC targets through a CODESYS gateway
post.description: Active gateway scans and findAddressByIp can block in CODESYS. Prefer cached scan or known project bindings until this is isolated in a worker.
login/connect is opt-in and uses OnlineChangeOption.Keep. It does not download or start the PLC.

post.summary: Bind a project device to a PLC IP address
post.description: Guarded endpoint. Requires confirmBind=true because changing a project target can point it at a different PLC.

get.summary: List Modbus channels for a device

post.description: Creates a whole Modbus slave channel set. By default this uses the faster CODESYS native .export generation/import path when masterPath is supplied. Use mode=addParameter to force the legacy AddParameter loop, which is much slower.

put.description: Updates existing channel configuration structs in one CODESYS script. It does not create missing channels; missing names are returned in the response.

get.summary: Get IO mapping for a channel

put.summary: Set IO mapping for a channel

delete.summary: Clear IO mapping for a channel

post.description: Administrative escape hatch. Prefer dedicated endpoints for production workflows. Runs with one shared namespace, so top-level functions can call each other.

get.description: Session heartbeat, reservations, running jobs, simulators, adapters by USB serial, gateways by MAC (from the ARP cache) and aggregated warnings, such as a gateway whose address no longer matches its expected IP.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Sweep the gateways' /24 networks first to repopulate the ARP cache (a few seconds)

get.description: Tokens are never returned after creation.

post.description: Scopes: bench (everything), plc, adapter:<USB serial>, gateway:<MAC>. An overlapping active reservation returns 409. The returned token authorizes changes via X-Bench-Reservation. Unreserved scopes stay open to everyone.

parameters.name: X-Bench-Reservation
parameters.description: Reservation token. Required when another holder has reserved a scope this call changes; otherwise the call returns 423.

post.summary: Run a script as a job
post.description: Returns 202 at once; poll GET /api/v1/jobs/{jid}. Jobs run one at a time, in submission order, through the IDE session, with one shared namespace so script functions can call each other. session.report_progress({...}) inside the script shows as the job's progress (needs the current PERSISTENT_SESSION.py).

get.description: States: queued, running, succeeded, failed, cancelled. Running jobs include progress.

delete.description: A running CODESYS script cannot be interrupted (409).

get.summary: List serial adapters by USB serial
get.description: Current COM port, presence, registered label and bus, and owner (managed simulator with running, portOpen and last RX). A present but unregistered adapter carries a warning.

put.description: Stores label, wiredTo (gateway MAC) and notes locally. FTDI's Windows 'A' suffix is optional.

get.description: Current IP from the ARP cache and the expected IP; warns when they differ.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Sweep the expected /24 networks to repopulate ARP

parameters.name: probe
parameters.description: TCP-connect to each Modbus port. Briefly uses one of the gateway's client slots; off by default

confirmBind.description: Required true to change project target binding

mode.description: native generates a CODESYS .export and imports the slave device. addParameter uses the legacy native ParameterSet.AddParameter loop.

masterPath.description: Required for native mode. Dot-separated path from the PLC device to the Modbus master.

slaveAddress.description: Modbus slave/server address used when native mode creates/imports the device.

replace.description: When true in native mode, deletes an existing device with the same name before import. Keep false unless replacing a generated device intentionally.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait, up to 300. Use /api/v1/jobs for longer work.
